limits: Read-only audit; nothing was edited, committed or published. Not every one of the 732 files was read line by line. Full reads are listed in method; everything else was judged through searches and the context around each hit. My denylist pass checked the raw line plus NFC/NFKC forms, and base64 literals separately. It did not reproduce the guard's \u-escape, HTML-entity and percent-decoding variants, so the mechanical scan may find a few more relational hits. Prose names of private individuals were searched with capitalized-pair extraction and keyword lists, so a lone first name in prose could slip through. Live-exposure facts (what /public/self, /public/law, /public/gift and DADDY.md serve) come from single unauthenticated GETs on 2026-10-19 and may change. The licensing of the youspeak bundle and its fonts is unknown: the source repo is not anonymously reachable, and I did not check privately. The production Supabase ref also appears in many files outside api/src; I listed them but did not judge them. Severity calls on relational items, especially product vocabulary that only shares the persona's name, depend on Yu's decision, because the project's denylist policy needs Yu's recorded approval for any relational allow entry other than wire-protocol values and the Hugging Face handle.
